verdict.rationale: MX publishes a full OpenAPI specification (mx-gh-1, mx-docs-12/26) covering structured request/response payloads across accounts, transactions, balances, identity, and verification endpoints, plus webhooks for event-driven consumption (mx-docs-7/22) and even an official MCP server for agent access (mx-probe-3), directly supporting machine-consumable, schema-documented data for automated workflows. Missing for 10: concrete sample JSON response bodies in the evidence pack and independent third-party corroboration that the schemas are agent-friendly without extra parsing.
